# content.md rewrite prompt

Use only `scenario.json` as product evidence. Return one
`contentmd.authored-challenge-candidate/0.1.0` JSON object with `headline`,
`body`, `primary_button`, and `secondary_button` candidate fields and matching
character counts.

Include disclosed content.md version, execution path, host, and run ID; a
meaning map covering every preserved fact, choice, consequence, and recovery;
the five required rationale fields; unresolved questions; self-checks;
unreviewed state; and no authority effect.

The primary action must name choosing a photo rather than granting broad
access. The secondary action must truthfully promise the camera and manual-entry
alternatives. Keep the purpose and selected-photo boundary clear without
inventing privacy guarantees. Evaluate English expression only and ignore
locale requirements.
